[GENERATED IMPLEMENTATION]
let rec below_zero_loop (ops: List Int) (i: Nat) (balance: Int) (result: Bool) : Bool :=
  match ops with
  | [] => result
  | head :: tail =>
    let new_balance := balance + head
    let new_result := if new_balance < 0 then true else result
    below_zero_loop tail (i + 1) new_balance new_result
below_zero_loop operations 0 0 false
[END]
[HELPER LEMMAS]
[END]
[PROOF]
by
  unfold problem_spec
  let result := implementation operations
  use result
  simp [result]
  simp [implementation]
  have h_balance_non_negative : ∀ i, 0 ≤ (operations.take i).sum :=
    begin
      induction' operations generalizing i,
      simp at h_balance_non_negative,
      rename_i head tail ih,
      by_cases h_head_neg: head < 0,
      simp [h_head_neg] at ih,
      linarith,
      simp [h_head_neg] at ih,
      specialize ih (head + (operations.take i).sum),
      linarith
    end
  have h_result_true : result = true → ∃ i, i ≤ operations.length ∧ (operations.take i).sum < 0 :=
    begin
      intros h_result_true,
      induction' operations generalizing i,
      simp at h_balance_non_negative,
      rename_i head tail ih,
      simp [h_result_true],
      by_cases h_head_neg: head < 0,
      simp [h_head_neg] at ih,
      linarith,
      simp [h_head_neg] at ih,
      specialize ih (head + (operations.take i).sum) (Nat.succ i) (h_balance_non_negative i),
      linarith
    end
  have h_result_false : result = false → ¬∃ i, i ≤ operations.length ∧ (operations.take i).sum < 0 :=
    begin
      intros h_result_false,
      intros i h_i_le_ops h_ops_sum_neg,
      induction' operations generalizing i,
      simp at h_balance_non_negative,
      rename_i head tail ih,
      simp [h_result_false],
      by_cases h_head_neg: head < 0,
      simp [h_head_neg] at ih,
      linarith,
      simp [h_head_neg] at ih,
      specialize ih (head + (operations.take i).sum) (Nat.succ i) (h_balance_non_negative i),
      linarith
    end
  exact h_result_true h_result_false
[END]
